extDescription.message: Speak fluent internet. Text, selection, whole page in one click, privately or with AI: GPT, Claude, DeepSeek, OpenRouter.

downloadingNote.message: One-time download by Chrome; later translations work offline.

detectedUncertain.message: Looks like $1, not sure. Pick the language if wrong.

needDownload.message: Translating $1 → $2 needs a language model download (about 80 MB).

needDownloadUnsure.message: Translation direction unclear: it looks like $1. Download the $1 → $2 language model (about 80 MB), or choose the language yourself.

truncated.message: Only the first $1 characters were translated. Translate the rest separately.

emptyHint.message: Paste text - the translation appears automatically.

selectText.message: Select a word or phrase first.

pageAutoOn.message: Next pages on this site will be translated automatically.

pageLimited.message: Large page: only the first $1 blocks are translated.

pageNothing.message: No translatable text found on this page.

pageCloudConfirm.message: Send about $1 characters of this page to $2? The provider may charge for it.

pageSensitive.message: This looks like a sensitive site (bank, mail, payments).

cloudNotice.message: Selected text is sent to $1 for translation and may be billed by the provider.

restrictedHere.message: Chrome does not allow extensions on this page. Paste the text into Transello instead.

err_api_missing.message: Built-in translation is turned off in this browser (Brave does this on some systems). Connect a cloud AI in Settings, or use Google Chrome.

err_local_unavailable_here.message: Local translation is not available here. Open the Transello window.

err_unsupported_pair.message: This language pair is not supported by local translation. Pick another language or connect a cloud provider.

err_unknown_language.message: Could not detect the language. Pick the source language.

err_needs_download.message: This direction needs a language model download first (about 80 MB).

err_download_failed.message: The language model could not be downloaded (offline or not enough disk space?).

err_local_failed.message: Chrome's built-in translator could not start on this device, although the language model is installed. Check chrome://components (TranslateKit) and free disk space, or connect a cloud provider in Settings.

err_download_stalled.message: The language model download is not progressing. Check your connection and retry.

err_too_long.message: The text is too long for one request.

err_restricted_page.message: Chrome does not allow extensions on this page.

err_no_selection.message: Select a word or phrase first.

err_auth.message: The key or sign-in is invalid or expired. Check it in Settings.

err_forbidden.message: Access denied by the provider (403). Check the key's permissions or model access.

err_rate_limit.message: Too many requests (429). Wait a moment and retry.

err_quota.message: No credits or quota left at the provider.

err_context_limit.message: The text is too long for this model. Translate a shorter part.

err_server.message: The provider has a server error. Retry later.

err_empty_output.message: The model returned an empty answer (a reasoning model may have used up its token limit). Retry, or pick another model in Settings.

err_no_key.message: Connect the provider in Settings first.

err_no_permission.message: Allow Transello to access the provider's API in Settings.

err_consent_required.message: Confirm sending text to the cloud provider first.

privLocal.message: The built-in translator runs on your device: your text goes nowhere.

privCloud.message: With a cloud AI, your text and key go from your browser straight to the provider you chose, and nowhere else.

privKeys.message: Keys are stored only on this device and never synced.

privNoServer.message: Transello has no server, no analytics and no ads.

pvTrustInline.message: The key stays on this device and is sent only to $1.

pvTrustCheck.message: Check it yourself in the source code

pvDisconnected.message: Disconnected. The key was deleted from this device.

pvKeyStorage.message: The key is kept only on this device (chrome.storage.local), is never synced and is not visible to web pages. It is not an OS keychain: anyone with access to this Chrome profile could read it.

pvTestNote.message: One short request, usually a fraction of a cent.

pvPermDenied.message: Without access to $1 this provider cannot be used.

pvOauthOpenRouterNote.message: OpenRouter creates a key tied to your account; usage is paid from your OpenRouter balance.

pvOauthOpenAI.message: Sign in with ChatGPT is unavailable: OpenAI currently allows it only for local apps with a 127.0.0.1 callback, which a browser extension cannot receive. Use an API key.

pvOauthClaude.message: OAuth is unavailable for third-party extensions. Anthropic recommends an API key from Claude Console.

optKeepDraft.message: Keep the popup text until the browser closes
